title: Big Bold Fruity Honey Melon 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Big Bold Fruity Nic Salts Honey Melon captures the refreshing and sweet taste of ripe honeydew melon, offering a rich and juicy vape experience. This e-liquid delivers a smooth and satisfying blend of melon flavours, perfect for vapers who enjoy light and refreshing fruity profiles. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Big Bold Nic Salts are designed for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) starter kits and pod devices. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, these nic salts provide smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine relief, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers looking for a fast, satisfying alternative to traditional tobacco products. If you love this flavour, there are several other flavours to try from Big Bold’s collection, including Menthols, Creamy and Fruity flavours. Explore such beguiling blends as Honey Melon, Banana Milk, and Vanilla Custard for a Big Bold burst of flavour and a taste sensation like no other.
